issues.description: The problem statement and solution expect a Stock method named emptyStock(), but the template Stock class provides a method named clearInventory() instead. This naming/signature mismatch is structural: students following the specification or the solution reference will look for emptyStock() and won't find it in the template, causing confusion or compile errors if they call the expected method name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Stock class match the specification and solution by renaming clearInventory() to emptyStock(), or add an emptyStock() method that delegates to clearInventory(). Ensure the method name in the template matches the problem statement (emptyStock) to avoid confusion.
